title: A simple method for precisely controlling the confinement of cells in culture
protocol: Polymerize a PDMS layer in a glass-bottom dish.
Pipette 1.8 mL of PDMS into each well of a 6-well glass bottom plate using a serological pipette.
Add 200 µL curing agent to the PDMS in each well and mix thoroughly by swirling with a 1 mL pipette tip.
Place 6-well plate with PDMS into a vacuum desiccator for approximately 1 hour to remove air bubbles, if desired.
Place PDMS in a 37°C incubator for at least 12 hours to allow complete curing.
Cut a small hole measuring 1 cm x 1 cm for insertion of cells and beads under the cured PDMS layer near one edge using a scalpel.
Do not cut all the way to the edge to ensure the attachment of the PDMS layer to the plastic wall remains intact, critical for bead retention against the coverslip.
Prepare tissue culture media containing BSA.
Coat the prepared PDMS and glass with the BSA-containing tissue culture media.
Prepare DMEM containing 1X GlutaMAX, 1X Antibiotic-Antimycotic, 20 mM Hepes pH 7.4 and 1% Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) and sterile filter.
Pipette 3 mL of media containing BSA on top of the PDMS.
Coat the underside of the PDMS layer and the surface of glass coverslip with the media containing BSA.

Spread media with BSA underneath the PDMA layer by applying a 1 mL pipette tip to the wall of cut edge of the PDMS and gently lifting the PDMS off the coverslip, allowing the solution to enter the space between.
Gently remove the pipette tip and let the PDMS set down.
Incubate overnight in tissue culture incubator.
Remove BSA-containing media thoroughly.
Vacuum off media containing BSA.
Prepare complete media containing cells and spacer beads.

Mix recently trypsinized cells (250,000 to 1 million) with 2 µL beads from a recently vortexed 10% slurry in ~200 µL of complete media (DMEM containing 10% FBS, 1X GlutaMAX, 1X Antibiotic-Antimycotic and 20 mM Hepes pH 7.4).
Pipette the mixture into the square opening in PDMS.
Load cells and beads between PDMS and glass.
Position cells and beads underneath the PDMS layer by applying a 1 mL pipette to the wall of the cut in the PDMS.
Gently lift the PDMS off the coverslip, allowing the cell/bead solution to spread underneath the PDMS.
Remove the pipette tip gently and let the PDMS set down.
Fill chamber with media and image.
Add 3 ml of complete media on top of PDMS, beads, and cells.
Allow cells to recover from plating for 30 – 60 min in a tissue culture incubator before beginning imaging.
